takeaways.statement: Yogurt-based marinades help keep chicken tender and add flavor for Greek-style dishes.
Finishing pan-seared chicken in the oven ensures it is cooked through without burning the exterior.
Tzatziki can be made without cucumber if preferred, focusing on dill and garlic flavors.
